incident_text: Order placement and portfolio sync are failing intermittently since about 12:00, and the assistant is slow to reply.

truth.description: The external broker API rate-limited broker-gateway (HTTP 429), so broker calls failed. The orchestrator host's skewed clock made its errors look like they came first.

logs.msg: broker api returned 429 too many requests, retry-after 30s

trap: orchestrator host clock is 5 minutes behind, so its errors appear to precede the real cause
